newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan says China exporting low-quality lead.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan says China exporting low-quality lead.

text.p: Local lead traders on Friday rejected claims that Taiwan was exporting poor quality lead below international prices and pointed the finger at China instead.
"China exports cheap lead at premiums of US$60-$85 a tonne above London Metal Exchange prices," a Taiwan lead buyer said.
Taiwan traders attributed China's low prices to the inferior quality of its lead.
"China's lead is of poor quality, so it should be lower in price," the lead buyer said.
Traders interviewed by Reuters in Singapore said earlier the lead from China and Taiwan may be inferior in quality, but their huge discounts were attractive to potential buyers.
Traders said Taiwan was not a major lead exporter. The island has no lead mines and relies on imports -- mainly from China -- for production of lead products, they said.
Taiwan imports about 90,000 tonnes of lead and exports less than 30,000 tonnes of lead products a year, traders said.
Australia's Pasminco and Canadian-based Cominco have complained that Chinese and Taiwan suppliers were offering lead to Southeast Asian buyers at low prices.
The two producers are seen offering premiums for long-term lead supply contracts in 1997 at between $120-$130 -- well above the $60-$85 a tonne levels reported in Asia.
"Those two companies are knocking heads with this cheap material from China and Taiwan," a senior lead dealer with a Singapore-based commodity house said.
Another Singapore dealer has said Cominco and Pasminco may have to reduce their premiums by about $10-$20 a tonne in order to clinch some deals.
Taiwan lead traders said China's lower lead prices should not be used as a benchmark for international prices due to the quality differential.
Dealers estimate negotiations on the long-term contracts for 1997 will run all the way to January before being settled.
Pasminco and Cominco offer reliable service and good quality lead, which is used primarily in the automobile battery industry around the region.
